title: Feel Shift gains healing and hope from self-ruin with new single, "Now I See (Unplugged)"
htmlContent: "Now I See (Unplugged)" is like the moment before dawn, when awareness and freedom come together in a calm place. This simple, personal version of Feel Shift demonstrates what healing looks like in real-time. The song stems from a deeply personal experience and was written during a time of traumatic betrayal, which is why every lyric and chord is so intense. "Now I See (Unplugged)" came from a single night of enlightenment, when the artist realised that being broken was not the end, but the beginning. It is about facing the pain, understanding it, and finding light in its reflection. The song is appealing because it is so simple. It feels more like a confession than a performance, with the artist sharing their most intimate experiences with the audience. https://open.spotify.com/track/2VvXUonQiaCkD0ZCZJe7pV The song "Now I See" talks about a change that everyone can relate to. It tells people who are sad that they don't have to stay that way. This song is for those who want to share their pain and for those who need to know that healing is possible and already underway. When viewed through the lens of "BETRAYED," this song marks a turning point and the emotional shift from despair to acceptance. Its honesty is graceful, and its self-control is powerful. Feel Shift has created a safe space to listen to music. "Now I See (Unplugged)" demonstrates that healing is quiet, genuine, and profound, and that's precisely what the world needs to hear at times.
